verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an online government service that holds user data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no user-facing control over retention or deletion. The only related item says ID.me selfie, video and biometric data are deleted automatically, which is a fixed policy of the identity-proofing step and not a control the user operates, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
